mapper.insert: INSERT INTO income_sources(user_id, account_id, payment_name, payment_day, memo, gross_amount) VALUES (#{userId}, #{accountId}, #{paymentName}, #{paymentDay}, #{memo}, #{grossAmount})
mapper.select: SELECT income_source.id, income_source.user_id, income_source.account_id, account.account_name, account.account_number, income_source.payment_name, income_source.payment_day, income_source.memo, income_source.gross_amount, income_source.is_deleted, income_source.deleted_at, income_source.created_at, income_source.updated_at FROM income_sources income_source JOIN accounts account ON account.id = income_source.account_id WHERE income_source.user_id = #{userId} AND income_source.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY income_source.payment_day ASC, income_source.id ASC

SELECT income_source.id, income_source.user_id, income_source.account_id, account.account_name, account.account_number, income_source.payment_name, income_source.payment_day, income_source.memo, income_source.gross_amount, income_source.is_deleted, income_source.deleted_at, income_source.created_at, income_source.updated_at FROM income_sources income_source JOIN accounts account ON account.id = income_source.account_id WHERE income_source.id = #{id} AND income_source.user_id = #{userId} AND income_source.is_deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE( SUM(gross_amount), 0 ) FROM income_sources WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
